item.title: 计费和赠送额度问题
item.body: 我是去年刚听说Trae开始，就开始使用Pro的用户，当时就是看中Trae的请求次数才购买的年费，结果我才发现，早就给我换成Token计费了。 1、关于赠送额度问题 我还看到很多人都有赠送的余额，我请问Pro用户是没有余额吗？还是只是我没有？ 2、关于请求次数的问题 官方客服不是说，Pro用户使用Gemini3 Pro，可以使用差不多600次么。见图 可是现在哪里还有Gemini3 Pro，因此我使用了理论上应该更便宜的Gemini3-Flash来进行尝试，用官方给我这个Pro账号(图一 额度加赠送，总共20美刀)，单次(比Gemini3 Pro更应该便宜)Gemini3-Flash请求 因此可以看到，我的账号在Pro的计划下，总共只有20额度，仅仅能使用Gemini3-Flash进行约30.7次80k上下文的对话 想退款的可以看issue#2488、#2483，想使用的建议转去使用Claude Cli+ 任意coding plan，或者使用windsurf等其他Code AI Idle，一样的价格，至少别人还能用Claude Code。Trae本身用不了就算了，还容易给你改出来BUG让你重复改一个地方，现在没有这些优势的情况下，改用Token计费，你也就一个次数计费是优势，不然凭什么我们能接受Trae？ ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Regarding the bonus balance I’ve noticed that many people have a bonus balance. Do Pro users not have a bonus balance, or is it just me? 2. Regarding the number of requests Didn’t the official customer service team say that Pro users can make about 600 requests when using Gemini 3 Pro? See image But the Gemini3 Pro is no longer available, so I decided to try the Gemini3-Flash, which should theoretically be cheaper. I used the Pro account provided by the official platform (Figure 1: credit limit plus bonus, totaling $20) to make a single request with Gemini3-Flash (which should be cheaper than Gemini3 Pro). As you can see, my account has a total quota of 20 under the Pro plan, which is only enough for about 30.7 conversations of around 80,000 characters using Gemini3-Flash. If you want a refund, check issues #2488 and #2483. If you want to continue using the service, I recommend switching to Claude CLI + any coding plan, or using other Code AI IDLs like Windsurf. For the same price, at least you’ll still be able to use Claude Code. Trae itself doesn’t work, so forget about it—it even tends to introduce bugs that force you to keep fixing the same spot over and over. Now that it lacks these advantages and has switched to token-based billing, your only real advantage is per-use billing. Otherwise, why should we accept Trae?
